summary: Phase 1 internal API boundary verified: API-key middleware (constant-time, fail-closed) applied to all 15 MCP internal routes, production startup fails without MCP_INTERNAL_API_KEY, route-level tests for missing/invalid/valid keys all pass; NetworkPolicy and TLS public path confirmed consistent with spec.
follow_up: Implementation was already present as uncommitted working-tree changes; no new edits were required this session
Production secret commoncal-mcp-secrets must contain a non-empty mcp-internal-api-key before deploying this core image, or startup will fail by design
important_context: MCP server calls core via public HTTPS origin (MCP_INTERNAL_API_BASE=https://cal.hajnal.space), so MCP-to-core traffic flows through traefik ingress; core NetworkPolicy admits only the traefik namespace
Header contract is x-mcp-api-key on both sides (backend middleware and mcp-server/src/internal_client.rs)
Middleware fails closed: an empty configured key rejects every request, so development without the env var is safe
